description: This file defines a mock class RenderSessionMock which inherits from RenderSessionImpl, intended for unit testing. It includes mock method declarations for various actions related to a rendering session, primarily using Google Mock (gmock). The class is used to simulate RenderSession behavior in tests.

classes.name: RenderSessionMock
classes.description: A mock subclass of RenderSessionImpl for unit testing, providing mocked implementations of rendering session behaviors.
